title: Shaded Textures
description: Adds a few texture packs mods and a shader to make the game feel soothing and perfect. NO DEPENDENCIES!
body:
Thanks for **2000 downloads** on Curseforge!

**Shaded Textures** is a modpack that makes Minecraft look nicer but keeping the feel vannila friendly. It adds shaders for lighting and mods for upgrading the feel and resource packs too.
<iframe width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/wsIYfg049c8" title="YouTube video player" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen></iframe>
In this modpack there is a few things that make the game better down below are some of the things I used:
Entity Model Features
Needed for fresh animations.
******************************************************************************************************************
Entity Texture Features
Needed for fresh animations.
******************************************************************************************************************
Fabric API
Needed for everything
******************************************************************************************************************
Iris
(Optional) Needed for Complementary Shaders - Reimagined
******************************************************************************************************************
Sodium
(Optional) Boosts your FPS.
******************************************************************************************************************
Fresh Animations
(Optional) Gives all mobs lifelike animations.
******************************************************************************************************************
Beautiful Enchanted Books
(Optional) Makes enchanted books more readable by looking at them.
******************************************************************************************************************
Fast Better Grass
(Optional) Fast full grass texture pack.
******************************************************************************************************************
Unique Dark Refined
(Optional) A dark take at the Minecraft UI
******************************************************************************************************************
Complementary Shaders - Reimagined
(Optional) Best shader (In my optinion)
******************************************************************************************************************
Fresh Animations: Player Extension
(Optional) an extension for the Fresh Animations mod that adds the animations to the player.
******************************************************************************************************************
Visuality
(Optional) And particles to mobs when attacked or triggered.
******************************************************************************************************************
Not Enough Animations
(Optional) Adds first person animations to third person.
******************************************************************************************************************
Bee's Fancy Crops
(Optional) Brings crops to a new level by adding puffy details to them.
******************************************************************************************************************
Cloth Config
Needed for visuality.
